name: Nexum Laevo Prima

bonuses.name: Champion
bonuses.text: This Threat may use Ruin Actions and has 2 personal Ruin.

bonuses.name: Radiation
bonuses.text: Nexum's body is highly radioactive. Any creature that ends its Turn within 10m of Nexum must make a DN 5 Toughness Test. On a failure, it takes 1d3 Mortal Wounds, 1d6 Shock Damage, and is Staggered for 1 Round.

bonuses.name: Mechadendrites
bonuses.text: Nexum can make four attacks with her Mechadendrites on her Turn without Multi-Attack penalties.

abilities.name: Grasping Mechadendrites
abilities.text: Spend 1 Ruin. Nexum wraps multiple Mechadendrites around a target. The target must succeed on a DN 7 Athletics (S) Test or become Restrained. Nexum can move a Restrained target by up to 5m in any direction, once per Round.

note: Speed 0 as printed. The print lists the Arc-Ballistic and Servo as bullets under 'Mechadendrites:', then the Ray, all in one ACTION box.
